id.description: Google Drive file id, or the relative path for a local collection

kind.description: photo=captured · design=finished artwork · screenshot=screen capture · diagram=chart or slide · logo=isolated brand mark

medium.description: physical=printed material or a real object · digital=on-screen artwork · na=not applicable. A printed mockup is design + physical.

caption.description: one factual sentence, written by the vision model

has_text.description: the image has text baked into it; answered by the vision model, which is the only party that can see it

text.description: the words inside the image, transcribed by the vision model. Not OCR from Drive: the Drive property this was once read from does not exist, so indexes written before that was found carry an empty string here and has_text false on every line

labels.description: retired. It held Drive's own image labels, read from a property that does not exist in the Drive API, so it was always empty; no longer written, still present in older indexes

hash.description: file checksum; this is what makes updates incremental
